caption: The drawing depicts a long-sleeved dress displayed flat with the front facing upwards. The fabric of the dress is light brown or beige and covered with a small, evenly spaced floral pattern in red, blue, and green. The dress features a row of large, round black buttons running down the center from the collar to the hem. There is a large black lace trim running diagonally across the upper chest and shoulders as well as around the bottom hem, and a narrower black lace trim encircles the cuffs. The dress has a slightly fitted waist and a flared skirt that extends to about mid-calf length. The composition is centralized and the background is plain off-white, drawing focus entirely to the dress.
title: Challis Girl's Dress
